counterfactual_text: The sharply edged butter is suddenly replaced by a finished liquid pool covering the pan.
positive_text: The butter first softens and rounds at the edges, then its footprint expands continuously into a liquid pool.
semantic_text: A pat of butter in a warm pan softens, loses its sharp edges, and spreads into a liquid pool. Required visible entities: one pat of butter; one warm pan; uncovered pan surface around the butter. At the beginning: butter: firm, compact, intact, and sharply edged; pan surface: exposed around the butter with minimal liquid butter. Required state changes: butter firmness: firm to soft; butter boundary: sharp to rounded and receding; butter footprint: compact pat to spreading liquid pool. These event variables are allowed to change: butter firmness; butter edge sharpness and shape; butter footprint and liquid fraction. Preserve throughout: static close camera; pan identity and position; background and lighting; one pat of butter; one warm pan; the same butter material through the change.
